verdicts.title: Two-dimensional magnetic interactions in LaFeAsO
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Inelastic neutron scattering measurements demonstrate that the magnetic interactions in antiferromagnetic LaFeAsO are two-dimensional. Spin wave velocities within the Fe layer and the magnitude of the spin gap are similar to the \textit{A}Fe$_2$As$_2$ based materials.
